comparison.objective: Register a scored circuit-board panel on a break edge, snap off the board, and tray it.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual brace-and-bend force control, edge registration, controlled fracture, and freed-part transfer.
comparison.success_condition: The break must occur at the registered score with the prescribed downward motion and limited twist, followed by valid board and frame placement and 1 s release/rest.
comparison.reason: Controlled depaneling is destructive fracture along a score; it does not test reversible housing preservation or terminal-latch release.
